correctness.rationale: An exact double count gives \(i_3^{(4)}(G)=\binom{n}{4}-(2n/3)(n-3)+P(G)\). Degree \(2\) implies no \(4\)-set contains three hyperedges and every hyperedge belongs to at most one pair intersecting in two vertices, so \(P(G)\le n/3\). Equality translates in the cubic dual to one doubled incident edge and one simple incident edge at every vertex, hence alternating even cycles. Exhaustive small-order and direct hypergraph checks agree.

originality.rationale: The closest recent paper proves the \(k=4\) coefficient bound only for cross-edge-free triple systems and proves a separate total-count theorem for \(2\)-regular odd-uniform hypergraphs. Searches for the unrestricted \((r,d,k)=(3,2,4)\) coefficient formula and alternating-cycle equality classification found no matching or stronger indexed result.

value.rationale: The theorem verifies a complete unrestricted parameter slice of the coefficient-wise conjecture, supplies an explicit extremal coefficient formula, and classifies every equality isomorphism type via a transparent dual structure.
